description:
Product Engineer 

 Scandit TAMPERE 

 Imagine the what. Build the how.
 Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

 Your opportunity 

 As one of Scandit's Product Engineers, you will work as part of the product squad to evaluate and build out our solution capabilities using multi-barcode reading, tracking, augmented reality, and text recognition. You will partner closely across the software engineering and product teams to develop new products and features, as well as continuously optimize our existing products.

 You'll ensure new developments and features meet our performance, user experience, and enterprise-grade standards, while solving customers' challenges along the way. Based on a hypothesis-driven discovery approach with direct customer feedback, you'll collect data and evidence to understand the challenges and product requirements in detail. Daily interaction with our engineering teams will ensure a fast feedback loop and agile development.

 Responsibilities include working with customers to understand their needs, building proof of concepts, and evaluating the technical performance of existing products. This ensures data capture quality and performance meet enterprise-grade standards at every stage of development, including rebuilding setups and replicating customer use cases in our labs.

 As an ideal candidate, you have initial programming experience, and you're interested in building functional prototypes and test setups with a strong focus on user and customer needs. You're data-driven and thrive in fast-paced evaluation work. You enjoy communicating with technical or business stakeholders, as well as discussing product specifications with the wider product team.

 
 Work closely together with engineering and the wider product team to define product quality metrics of prototypes and products

 Build test systems for measuring the quality and performance of new product features or improvements

 Evaluate and drive the analysis of customer feedback and requests

 
 Who we look for 

 
 Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science, ideally with an industrial engineering or robotics background

 2+ years of industry experience

 Strong customer focus and problem-solving skills

 A metric- and data-driven mindset

 Interest in working on the intersection of engineering and business

 Excellent English communication skills, both oral and written

 Eligible to work in Finland and available to work at our Tampere office at least 3 days per week 

 
 The good stuff 
 Here are just some of the reasons why people choose to build their career at Scandit:

 
 We are certified as a “Great Place to Work” in 7 countries!

 Smart, people-first culture

 Flexible, office, hybrid or home working

 Innovation hackathons 

 Global team outings 

 Festive/end of year all company celebrations 

 Your birthday off 

 Learning and development opportunities

 An attractive individual equity plan in a high growth company 

 Top notch tech pack to enable you to do your most productive work

 Brand new optimized-for-hybrid working HQ in Zurich as well as local offices in hotspots London, Tampere, Warsaw, Boston and Tokyo

 As well as specific benefits related to the location you are joining

 
 At Scandit we strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our employees. We believe that our products and services benefit from our diverse backgrounds and experiences and are proud to be a safe space for all.
